segments.intent: Count distinct companies whose postings mention both R and data visualization
segments.value:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company) AS companies_requiring_r_and_data_visualization FROM scout_postings WHERE (description LIKE '%R%' OR skills_json LIKE '%R%') AND (LOWER(description) LIKE '%data visualization%' OR LOWER(skills_json) LIKE '%data visualization%')
```

```

1                                          177
```
